about_pullquote: We treat every home like our own—honest pricing, no surprises, quality work.
about_para_1: PT Heating Plumbing & Bathrooms was founded on a simple principle: Coventry families deserve a heating engineer they can trust. Over 12 years, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, diagnosing problems honestly, and fixing them right the first time. We're Gas Safe registered and carry all parts and tools needed for most jobs—so you're not left waiting days for a repair.
about_para_2: Repeat customers form the backbone of our business because we don't upsell or use jargon to confuse you. Whether it's a midnight boiler failure or a planned bathroom refit, we bring the same professionalism and fair pricing. Your home, your heating, your budget—we respect all three.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in on Boxing Day. PT Heating came out within an hour—couldn't believe it. Mark diagnosed a faulty thermostat, replaced it, and charged us a fair price. Absolute lifesaver. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Just had a new bathroom fitted. The team was professional, tidy, and they explained everything as they went. Finished on time and to budget. Boiler works a treat too. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Had a leaking radiator in the bedroom. Phoned on a Saturday afternoon expecting to wait until Monday. They came out the same day, fixed it, and even flushed the system. Fair price, friendly blokes. 5 stars.
reviews.author: Michael T.
